description:
This course is based on the classical Islamic jurisprudence (fiqh) book Fath ul-Mu’een, written by Sheikh Zainuddin bin Abdul Aziz al-Malibari. It provides a deep dive into the Shafi’i school of thought, covering acts of worship (ibadah), transactions (mu’amalat), marriage (nikah), criminal law (hudood), and other key legal rulings.

Designed for serious students of knowledge, this course also integrates insights from the renowned commentary I’anat al-Talibeen.
